facts.text: {name} has played bridge with the Chief Executive every Thursday for eleven years.
The post of Team Leader was abolished in a reorganisation two years ago, and nobody has told {name}.
{name} wrote the company's values statement at a kitchen table, in one afternoon, for a bet.
{name} is the only person alive who knows the password to the system that pays everyone.
{name} was engaged for six years to the Head of Internal Audit. It ended badly, and the audit is still open.
{name} has kept a dated record of every promise made on this floor since 2014, and has made copies.
{name} reports privately to the Chief Financial Officer on what really happens at this level.
{name} has been on the redundancy list for two years. The list has been lost, and nobody dares to ask for it.
{name} has a signed offer from the company's largest competitor, and is staying on to see how this ends.
